about: The tractus of the formulary “Second Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Give praise to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endures forever. Who will declare the powers of the Lord? Who will make all His praises heard? Blessed are those who keep judgment and do justice at all times. Remember us, O Lord, in Your favor toward Your people; visit us with Your salvation.

ex.w004: The adjective is the predicate of an understood subject, the Lord, with the verb left out: “for [He is] good”.
